snippet.title: Bullet Hell Rhythm Game on Steam Next Fest 2026 - Shapes N Music Demo Available
snippet.description:
Shapes N Music is an upcoming difficult bullet hell rhythm game with a free demo on Steam Next Fest 2026.

Dodge and dash through hazards to master 11 challenging but fair levels perfectly synced to a soundtrack of argent metal, chiptune, rock, symphonic metal, and more.

Can you beat each level without taking a hit? Complete levels in fewer attempts than your friends, customize visuals, practice with double HP, and take on 4 more brutal game modes.

Wishlist now and play the free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3903050/Shapes_N_Music/

Trailer music:
● Dropzone - TRIAC
● Level ! Retro Remix - Dapper Husky
● Flamewall - Camellia
● "Chocominh" - Chocominh
● The Shadow of Death - David KBD
● Twinsanity - Spooder
● Camel Skyscrapers of Plasma Rain - Boy Meets Robot
